bundle_discount.label: Kit discount %
bundle_discount.info: Display only. Configure a matching Shopify automatic discount (e.g. % off at this piece count) so the saving actually applies at checkout. Leave at 0 if you have no such discount.

collection_list.label: Collections
collection_list.info: Leave empty to show all collections automatically.

details.label: Contact details
details.info: Shown beside the form in split layout

show_menu_products.label: Show featured products in mega menu

show_menu_featured.label: Show promo image tile in mega menu

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold (cents)
free_shipping_threshold.info: Cart total in cents to unlock free shipping

inventory_threshold.label: Low stock threshold
inventory_threshold.info: Show "Only N left" when stock is at or below this number (requires inventory tracking). Set to 0 to hide.

size_guide_page.label: Size guide page
size_guide_page.info: Shown in the size-guide modal when no size_chart metafield is set.

paragraph.content: Shows real Shopify local-pickup availability for the current variant. Renders nothing if no pickup location is set up.
Links to your store shipping, refund, and terms policies. Renders only the policies you have published.

video.label: Video
video.info: Shopify-hosted video. Takes priority over the image.

proof_caption.label: Proof caption
proof_caption.info: A short mono caption under the media, e.g. lab test or field condition.

note.label: Note
note.info: Optional line. Use for a real, configured bundle offer only — no fake discounts.

paragraph__source.content: Companions come from the product metafield custom.loadout (product list) when set, otherwise from the product blocks added below. The current product is excluded automatically.

paragraph.content: Add a review or app block (e.g. Judge.me, Loox, Okendo) here. The section stays hidden until an app block is added, so there is never blank space.

anchor_id.label: Anchor ID
anchor_id.info: The product rating links to #reviews. Keep this as reviews to connect them.

alt.label: Alt text
alt.info: Falls back to the image's own alt text.

logo_mobile.label: Mobile logo
logo_mobile.info: Optional — falls back to the main logo

font_accent.label: Accent / mono font
font_accent.info: Used for spec labels and codes

cart_free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold
cart_free_shipping_threshold.info: Cart total in your store currency to unlock free shipping

color_swatch_trigger.label: Swatch option name
color_swatch_trigger.info: Product option rendered as swatches (e.g. Color)

swatch_list.label: Custom swatch list
swatch_list.info: One per line — Name:#hexcolor or Name:image.png. Used when a product has no native swatch.
